notes: Complete list: 4 actions (src/actions.ts getActionDefinitions) and 2 feedbacks (src/feedbacks.ts getFeedbackDefinitions).

Protocol: WebSocket client to ws://<host>:<port>/api/session/liveupdate of the Disguise Designer Director (default port 80; src/index.ts:365, src/config.ts). Properties are addressed by a Designer object expression and a Python property expression.

The module works through the liveUpdateVariable feedback: it creates a subscription and a module variable $(liveupdate:<variableName>) that is updated when Disguise sends data. The four setToDisguise* actions write to a property by variableName and only work for a variable name that an existing liveUpdateVariable feedback has registered (otherwise the action logs a warning and does nothing). The variable name fields do not use variables (useVariables false).

setToDisguiseNumber evaluates the resolved value with new Function("return " + value), so any JavaScript expression is run, not only arithmetic (src/actions.ts processNumberValue). setToDisguiseJSON parses the resolved text as JSON.

liveUpdateVariable is an advanced feedback that returns an empty style object; its purpose is managing the subscription (callback, subscribe, unsubscribe). updateFrequency 0 means "as fast as possible" (the module passes no throttle).
The source log text mentions a "Refresh Subscriptions" action (src/index.ts:604) but no such action is registered. Variables and presets (src/variables.ts, src/presets.ts) are not catalogued.
Built on @companion-module/base ^1.6.3: options do not support expressions.
